prompt: A student draws a loop that checks N <= 100 before adding N, starts with N=1 and Sum=0, adds N, increments N, and returns to the test. Explain whether this is pre-test or post-test, whether the body could run zero times if the initial N were changed to 101, and why.
expectedAnswer: It is pre-test because the condition is checked before the body. If N starts at 101, 101<=100 is false immediately, so the body runs zero times and the chart proceeds to output. The condition controls entry into the loop.

rubric.criterion: Identifies the loop as pre-test
Explains the condition is checked before loop work
Evaluates 101<=100 as false
States the body runs zero times
Connects the result to pre-test behavior and chart exit
